## Samsung Accelerates Taylor, Texas Foundry Toward Mass Production Next Year

A faster-than-expected Taylor ramp tightens the advanced-node supply picture in the U.S. and could affect customer allocation decisions; watch for any named anchor customer announcement to confirm demand pull rather than supply push.

- Samsung is pulling forward the launch timeline for its Taylor, Texas fabrication facility, targeting mass production next year.
- The move marks a key advanced-node capacity milestone for Samsung's U.S. foundry strategy.
- No customer wins, node specifications, or production volumes are cited in coverage.
- Directional read is positive for Samsung foundry competitive positioning relative to peers expanding U.S. capacity.
